fact: Car 18 did not start the formation lap.
offence: Breach of Article B5.6.1 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, team radio and in-car video evidence. There is a requirement for cars to take part in the formation lap. Car 18 experienced mechanical problems on the grid, was removed appropriately off the grid, consequently repaired, and was able to start the race from the Pit Lane. Therefore it was unable to start the formation lap however the Stewards consider the above to be mitigating circumstances and so decide not to impose a penalty.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 18 Starting Procedure Infringement
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
